chunks.text: Okay, so to understand better how the order book works and

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: how exchanges work, let's look at a couple more example orders.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: For brevity, I'm leaving out the symbol IBM.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: This is all about IBM, so just keep that in mind.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: Okay, so a market order comes in to buy 100 shares at market.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So again, we see that there's 1,000 shares that people are willing to sell.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And the exchange has to give the best price to the client.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And so we would give the client 100 shares at this price.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So what happens, the order comes in, 100 shares go away.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And now the order book is changed just so

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: that there's 900 shares available here now instead of 1,000.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And the execution price is $100.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: Let's consider now a limit order.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: Someone wants to buy again 100 shares at a limit of 102 and 2 cents.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So looking at the order book, again we can satisfy that order.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And again, at $100.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So we're saying that we want to pay no more than $100 and 2 cents.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So again, we can execute it at 100.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And now this goes down to 800 shares instead of 900 being available.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And the execution price for this transaction, again, is $100.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And note also that that's less than that limit price of $100 and 2 cents.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: Let's look now at one last order, a market order,

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: where someone wants to sell 175 shares.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So that comes in.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And we have 100 shares available at $99.95.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So those get sold and there's none left there at that price.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So 100 shares get executed at $99.95.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So to get this 75 more shares, we need to go deeper into the book.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So we'll take these 50, zero left there.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: We still need 25 more shares to meet this order for 175.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So we go even deeper into the book and take some of these.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So after all these transactions,

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: the order book has been changed quite substantially.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And this client gets 100 shares at $99.95, 50 at $99.90, and 25 at $99.05.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So altogether, there's some average price at which this was executed for that client.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: Note now that as time has gone on, the executed prices have been decreasing.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: Clearly we're seeing that, you know,

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: that's a consequence of there's much more sell pressure than buy pressure.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So that's how the order book works and

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: how exchanges use order books to facilitate transactions between their clients.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: This is what an order book looks like in real life.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: Here in the middle we have prices.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And on either side here we see the order sizes.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: We're seeing here sell orders and how large they are.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And on this other side, buy orders and how large they are.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And the prices that they're being executed here are in the middle.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: And as you can see, it's changing dynamically and

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: rapidly as trades are executed.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: Here we see a price chart showing how the prices is going up and

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: down as these trades are being executed.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: So that's a live order book.

chunks.title: How orders affect the order book
chunks.text: This is using the trading platform called Think or Swim.
